name: Witch Hunter: Torch the Wicked stacks attack speed without refreshing its duration
contract: Torch the Wicked! 560226 (talent, Inquisition tab) reads 'Dealing damage with Flames of Sin now grants
$560227s1% attack speed, stacking up to $560227u times for $560227d. Application of this effect does not
refresh the duration.' 560227 is SPELL_AURA_MOD_MELEE_HASTE, BasePoints 1 + DieSides 1 = 2%, StackAmount 12,
SpellDuration 32 = 6000 ms. So the first Flames of Sin hit 802850 creates the buff for 6 s, later hits only add
stacks, and the buff ends 6 s after it was created even while Fire hits continue. The stock aura re-cast
(Aura::ModStackAmount) refreshes the duration on every stack, which the text excludes.
spell_ascension_witch_hunter_torch_stacks adds the stack without a refresh, but its Load read GetTarget(),
which is null outside effect hooks (AuraScript::GetTarget), so the script never attached and the native
PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL re-cast refreshed the buff on every Fire hit. Flourish 805365 grants Flames of Sin for
$/1000;s2 = 10 s; the fixture dual-wields (Worn Shortsword 1.9 s, Worn Dagger 1.6 s), so hits are at most
1.6 s apart. Three seconds after the first stack about 3 s remain (a refresh leaves at least 4.4 s), and
6.1 s after it the buff has expired and holds at most the one or two newest stacks (a refresh keeps it
stacking). Ratings remove melee misses, dodges and parries and the Fire hit's spell miss.

steps.label: SETUP: Torch the Wicked is active
SETUP: the off hand holds a weapon
Control: auto attacks without Flames of Sin grant no attack speed
Flourish grants Flames of Sin for 10 s
SETUP: Flames of Sin is active
The first Flames of Sin hit grants the attack speed buff
Keep hitting under Flames of Sin for 3 s
SETUP: Flames of Sin is still active
Later Flames of Sin hits add stacks
DISCRIMINATING: added stacks do not refresh the 6 s duration
Pass the 6 s after the first stack
SETUP: Flames of Sin is still active, so Fire hits continue
DISCRIMINATING: the buff expired 6 s after it was created and restarts
